So this is where the Monado was kept?[XENO:n ]
My dad took it from here...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Have you always been able to see the future?[XENO:n ]
You told me you are from a long line of seers.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Did you have the ability from birth?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Once, I too came into contact with the Monado.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:jaw jaw=off ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:jaw jaw=on ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Those that are to be seers[XENO:n ]
must touch the Monado.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
And a chosen few receive our power.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
That is the ceremony of my family.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
And the ceremony was held right here.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Shulk, why do you think you can see visions?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I hadn't really thought about it. After I[XENO:n ]
grabbed the Monado, I just saw things.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Your visions are the flow of ether itself.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Ether is the very source of our world's existence.[XENO:n ]
Where and how much ether there exists now,[XENO:n ]
and in the future, can be predicted.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

Therefore, in principle, the future of living beings[XENO:n ]
such as us can also be predicted.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]And there is one thing that makes possible[XENO:n ]
the visualisation of those predictions.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
You mean the Monado.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

The Monado can disrupt the ether, allowing you[XENO:n ]
to release certain powers. Which means?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Wouldn't it make sense to think visions[XENO:n ]
work on the same principle?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]With no one to control the outcome,[XENO:n ]
the future will never change.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

But what if someone were to disrupt[XENO:n ]
the future? What then?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

The future would be changed. Is that how[XENO:n ]
Zanza planned to defeat the Machine God?[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT19 ]But why go to such lengths?[XENO:n ]
What happened all those years ago?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Did you think it was just a myth?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I used to only believe in what I could see.[XENO:n ]
My home, my friends, the Monado itself![XENO:n ]
I knew those things were real.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

But when you took the Monado in your hand, you gained[XENO:n ]
the ability to see that which was not meant to be seen.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Are you saying I should stop?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]You are a fluctuation. As a fluctuation, you exist[XENO:n ]
outside the results of your predictions.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

The more you accept this existence,[XENO:n ]
the more malleable the world becomes.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]In fact, you have no choice but to accept it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
